stories.name: Semiconductor Stock Comparisons
stories.blurb: A series of headlines comparing which semiconductor and tech stocks are the better buy for 2026.

stories.name: TSMC Q3 earnings

stories.name: ASML High-NA EUV Deals

past.name: Memory Chip Rally

past.name: TSMC Intel chip race

events.name: ASML inks EUV deals with TSMC, Samsung

7.text: TSMC reported Q3 net profit of about NT$763.1 billion, a sixth straight record quarter, with advanced-processor demand outpacing supply. Articles recommend TSMC alongside Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom as a long-term AI infrastructure play, projecting continued growth through 2030.

11.text: TSMC’s Q3 results show 2nm at 8% of wafer revenue and advanced nodes at 79%, while it explores Texas investment. Other articles cover GlobalFoundries’ $21B New York fabs, Microsoft’s TSMC-made Maia 300, Samsung’s silicon photonics push, and Taiwan’s China chip-smuggling crackdown.

12.text: TSMC manufactures logic chips with a more stable business model, while Micron produces memory chips, according to a comparison of the two as AI chip players.

6.text: TSMC reported record Q3 results with EPS of $4.60 beating estimates by 3% and revenue up 41% year-over-year to $46.72 billion, driven by AI-chip demand, and raised its full-year growth outlook. Despite the beat-and-raise, the stock fell back to where it traded a month ago.

5.text: ASML reported record Q3 revenue (€11.7B, 56% growth), raised full-year guidance to €44–45B, and said it can't meet AI-driven demand through 2028, giving it pricing power. TSMC appears only as a customer context; the articles focus on ASML, not TSMC developments.

10.text: TSMC shares were caught in a broad chip-stock sell-off as a hot inflation report and the start of earnings season pushed the S&P 500 and Nasdaq down. The articles mention TSMC only as one of several chip names in focus, with no company-specific news.
